versions.changelog: v2.0.1: 二次全流程时序与一致性校验 — 修正2.3 VRAM编码模型归属(27B-MTP-CODER/UD-coder)、澄清2.6失活检测语义、规范化3.3复杂度公式、4.2门禁凭证表加注核验不产出凭证、统一PASS/RETRY决策语义、5.2补齐workboard API、6.5/6.6区分Worker/Planner职责、6.9审查决策按5.4状态流转重写、9.3人工介入条件对齐

Initial release of the competitive-agent-loop skill, implementing a 3-Agent competitive workflow for software development tasks.

- Introduces 3-Agent architecture (Planner, Generator, Evaluator) plus documentation agent and Sprint Contract mechanism.
- Dynamic workflow adapts to development task complexity, including multi-solution competition and time budgeting.
- Supports human approval at key checkpoints (contract, solution selection, handling repeated failures).
- Serial execution optimized for RTX 4090 VRAM constraints; avoids GPU contention.
- Built-in agent model fallback chains for robust operation and local model optimization.
- Standardizes required output formats for code, verification, and documentation steps.
